authority.native_reference_scope: Only unchanged pinned-upstream ndp-sim/jsons blobs listed by the authority contract are native reference instances.

rules.purpose: Bind every emitted target JSON leaf to an exact source instance, a target derivation, or an explicit inactive state.
Prevent registry or placeholder-handler presence from being treated as shape, dtype, qparam, layout, address, or schedule generalization authority.
Require an explicit typed and transactional boundary whenever multiple native primitives are composed into a target operator.

reference_classes.A: Exact op, dtype, shape, layout, qparams, topology, and current consumer.
reference_classes.B: Same primitive but at least shape, layout, qparam, address, or schedule differs.
reference_classes.C: Same hardware block but numeric type or operator semantics differs.
reference_classes.D: Project-added, untracked, unauthorized, or no usable reference.

claim_boundary: This policy validates complete target JSON provenance, native-reference applicability, handler capability, composition boundaries, and current-config comparison. It does not generate mapping, bitstream, execplan, SCA, a server package, server execution, natural-terminal evidence, formal D, E3, E4, or E5.
